facts.fact: The 23 July 2026 ICASEES release says partners support the implementation of the national strategy for the development of statistics (SNDS); no period or adoption date is given.
Oubangui Medias reports the SNDS, valid 2024-2028, was popularised in Bangui on African Statistics Day, with ICASEES saying the government will back it with 0.15% of the state budget.
A second-generation national statistics development strategy (SNDS2) was approved on 31 August 2023 and covers 2024-2028, according to ICASEES and its Director General.
ICASEES held a workshop on 18 July 2024 for the annual update of the SNDS2, assessing what worked the previous year and updating its activities.
